drhp.business: The Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited operates in three distinct manufacturing segments. The Plantation division cultivates and sells tea, primarily from South Indian estates. The Auto Electric Components division (Electromags) manufactures starter motor assemblies, switches, solenoid valves, and plastic assembled parts for automotive OEMs. The Healthcare division (Dental Products of India) produces and sells dental products to professionals across India.
drhp.certs: Reasonable Assurance on the BRSR obtained from TUV SUD South Asia Pvt. Ltd.
drhp.end_markets: Domestic (PAN India)|Exports (11% of turnover, including China, Iraq, Russia, Middle East, Europe)
drhp.expansion: The Corporation has not disclosed any new major capacity expansion or greenfield project with a commissioning timeline in the annual report. The auto electric components business (Electromags) mentions 'selective capacity expansion' as part of its operational performance discussion, but no specific project name, capacity quantum, or completion date is provided. The tea division sold the Dunsandle Estate during the year, indicating a portfolio rationalization rather than expansion. No other capex projects with timelines are described.

drhp.mdna: Tea: Improvements in harvesting and efficiencies reduced total operational expenses, resulting in higher sales revenue despite a 16% drop in overall production.|Dental: Sustained demand across key product categories, improved focus on value-led products and customer retention, and continued cost discipline and operational efficiencies.|Auto Electromags: Structurally positive outlook driven by EV adoption, electronics-heavy vehicle architecture, and India's positioning as a global sourcing hub for components.
drhp.one_liner: A 160-year-old diversified Wadia Group company with three manufacturing divisions: tea plantations, auto electric components (Electromags), and dental healthcare products.
